known_risks: The official QA evaluator uses gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and model-judge accuracy is not deterministic.
A custom judge using the pinned prompt is auxiliary evidence and cannot be reported as official LongMemEval accuracy.
LongMemEval-S evaluates histories of roughly 115k tokens and is distinct from LongMemEval-M.
The cleaned dataset replaced the original release after noisy sessions were removed.
fixture_redistribution: The complete upstream dataset remains outside this repository; only source metadata and normalized result evidence are committed.
